overview.text: Today's developments span hardware market dynamics, historical mathematical discoveries, agent systems, and software tooling. Nvidia faces scrutiny regarding GPU pricing strategies through circular financing deals, alongside a massive hardware theft during transit. Meanwhile, researchers applied AI to unlock Gödel's notebooks, revealing numerous proved theorems. In open source releases, the general-purpose AI agent system AI Manus launched to support tool execution within sandboxed environments. Additionally, the Hugging Face Blog introduced robot pick-and-place simulations using SimReady Assets and XYBench. Software updates include datasette-llm 0.1a11 and datasette-vega 0.7, while analytical commentary explored Nvidia's resilience and supply chain implications in a world without Jensen. These stories provide critical context on hardware supply constraints, emerging agent architectures, and foundational AI applications for technical leaders and researchers.

entries.title: datasette-vega 0.7
entries.summary: Release: datasette-vega 0.7 A new release of Datasette's longest untouched plugin, for rendering charts (using Vega-Lite) against data in a table or custom query. The last release was in July 2018!
